description: B holds 20 rows (IDs 1-20) on one data page. For a table-type recordset, and for a dynaset and a snapshot after MoveLast, each value [104.9 ;; 105 ;; 110 ;; 150 ;; -4.9 ;; -5 ;; -50] assigned to PercentPosition in turn, reading PercentPosition and ID after each. Then a fresh dynaset (RecordCount 1) with 199, 200 and 250 assigned, reading PercentPosition, AbsolutePosition, ID and RecordCount after each; and a forward-only recordset reading PercentPosition and assigning 0 and 50, with ID after each. Follows r-cursor-1b/percent-assign (101 and 100.5 move to the last row, -1 to the first) and r-fix-cursor-dao/arg-percentposition-150-readback (150 over 2 populated rows is 3001): decides whether the refusal starts where the truncated target row passes RecordCount, whether negative values truncate toward zero, and whether the count used is the populated one. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: R-CURSOR-1 CUR-POS PercentPosition assignment bounds on table-type, dynaset and snapshot over B (20 rows, one page): values above 100 and below 0 in turn, read back with ID.
